with a scar across one eyebrow
missing two fingers on one hand
with burn scars along one forearm
with an elaborate tattoo creeping up the neck
draped in clothes a size too fine
wearing a patched coat with too many pockets
with a limp they pretend not to have
with a gold tooth that flashes when they smile
smelling faintly of lamp oil and parchment
with small bones woven into their hair
who never removes their worn leather gloves
